vibe: Architectural, Brutalist, Structured, Confident, Professional B2B SaaS

rules: H1 must use tracking-tighter and font-black for maximum structural impact
Overlines must be tracking-[0.2em] and uppercase
Use strict left alignment for most text, never center-align everything to avoid 'generic SaaS slop'

layout_strategy.grid: Strict border-collapse style grids. Elements should have visible hard boundaries (1px solid black or dark gray border-[#0A0A0A] or border-gray-300).
layout_strategy.borders: Heavy use of border-b, border-r on structural containers to create a 'Blueprint/Matrix' feel. No soft drop shadows, use hard 1px borders instead.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-8 to p-16) inside bordered containers to prevent text collision.
layout_strategy.radius: rounded-none or max rounded-sm to maintain the brutalist architectural feel.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.layout: Fixed top. White background, hard 1px border-b border-black. Flex between. Logo on left, links in center, 'Demo aanvragen' solid orange button on right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: 2-column grid (md:grid-cols-2) with a hard vertical divider (border-r border-black). Left: Massive typography, overline, subtext, primary CTA. Right: The 'Overzicht/KPI dashboard' screenshot cropped aggressively in a structured box. Background uses the abstract_grid_bg.

sections.name: Feature Matrix (Beheer Suite)
sections.layout: Sticky Split Layout. Left column (sticky, 35vw) acts as an index/menu with 4 large numbered items. Right column (65vw) contains a vertical stack of the 4 remaining desktop screenshots (Locaties, Appartementen, Betalingen, Facturen) housed in strict bordered boxes with generous padding.

sections.name: Kiosk Flow (Tablet)
sections.layout: Horizontal Scrolling 'Filmstrip' or 4-column strict grid. Massive full-width section. Top half has section header. Bottom half is a horizontally scrolling track (or CSS grid if fits) of 4 tablet screenshots, showing the exact step-by-step payment flow. Each has an Orange/Cream theme background.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.layout: 3-column grid Matrix. No shadows, no floating cards. Just stark cells with border-r and border-b. Pro tier (SRD 950) is highlighted by inverted colors (Black background, white text, orange button).

sections.name: FAQ
sections.layout: Minimalist accordion. Each item has a strong 1px border-b. No backgrounds, just pure typography and high contrast.

sections.name: Final CTA
sections.layout: Massive solid Orange (#FF5C00) full-width block. Giant black typography. 'Klaar om uw vastgoed te digitaliseren?'. 2 buttons: 'Demo proberen' (Black) and 'WhatsApp ons' (Transparent with black border).

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Dark architectural footer (Black background, white text). Strict grid columns for links. Massive 'SuriRent' logo/text spanning the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Replace all unsplash placeholder URLs in media_urls with the ACTUAL 9 CDN screenshot URLs provided in your system prompt.
Do NOT use typical SaaS 'bento' or floating center-card templates.
Rely heavily on 'border-black/10' or 'border-black' on major layout elements to create a strict, architectural, blueprint-like grid.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Ensure leading-tight and tracking-tighter for a modern editorial feel.
Ensure the screenshots are placed inside containers with padding, rather than stretching edge-to-edge randomly. They represent professional tools.
Every button and interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute.
For the Kiosk section, use an overflow-x-auto or a strict 4-column grid (if they fit) to show the flow chronologically.
